title: Transparency in Team Contracts
abstract: arXiv:2611.07494v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In contract design, the principal is often better informed about the project's chances of succeeding than the agents. To incentivize effort, the principal has two main tools: first, to design a contract, sharing part of the project's success among the agents; second, to design a (Bayesian) persuasion scheme, selectively sharing information with the agents. In this work we are interested in the optimal combination of both these tools.   We tackle the joint problem through the prism of simplicity vs. optimality, and establish a stark dichotomy: The simple disclosure scheme of full transparency achieves a tight $4/3$-approximation to the optimal combination of information disclosure and team contract, when the team's production function is submodular. translated_abstract: 在合同设计中，委托人通常比代理人更了解项目成功的概率。为了激励代理人付出努力，委托人主要有两种工具：其一是设计一份合同，将项目成功的一部分收益在代理人之间进行分配；其二是设计一个（贝叶斯）说服方案，选择性地向代理人披露信息。在这项工作中，我们关注这两种工具的最优组合问题。我们从“简单性与最优性”的视角来解决这一联合问题，并建立了一个鲜明的二分结果：当团队的生产函数为次模函数时，完全透明这一简单的披露方案可以达到信息披露与团队合同最优组合的紧致的 4/3 近似比；相反，当生产函数为超模函数时，完全透明可能与最优结果相差任意远。我们为界定次模函数情形下差距而开发的技术，还进一步带来了……
tldr: 该论文揭示了合同设计与信息披露联合优化中的鲜明二分法：当团队生产函数为次模时，简单的完全透明策略即可达到最优组合的紧致 4/3 近似，而当生产函数为超模时，完全透明可能任意远离最优。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes a stark dichotomy in jointly optimizing contracts and information disclosure: full transparency achieves a tight 4/3-approximation to the optimal combination when the team's production function is submodular, but can be arbitrarily far from optimal when it is supermodular.
